# A component with state of its own under a `for` in a tab's panel. The panel
# is a record's content, rendered by one iteration of the strip's loop over its
# records, so that loop is no part of a copy's key (lower.BlockLoops). The
# inliner counted it when bubbletea spliced the card a cell per copy, keying
# each `k/copy`, and a test's `c.c[0].size` named no cell: the Go test did not
# build (`c.c undefined`).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func lookup(name string) async.Result[int] {
    return {ok=name.length()}
}

component card(name string) ui.node {
    var size option[int] = null
    async.query(on=name, fetch=lookup, :value=size)
    ui.text #len(value=size != null ? "{name} {size}" : name)
}

component shelf ui.node {
    var names = ["blueberry", "fig"]
    var tab = 0

    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=tab) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="one")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            for var n = names {
                card #c(name=n)
            }
        }
    }
    ui.button #swap(text="Swap", @click { names = ["grape"] })
}

func testACardInAPanelIsItsCopy(t test.Test, c shelf) {
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.c[0].len.value == "blueberry 9")
    t.assert(c.c[1].size == 3)
    c.swap.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.c[0].size == 5, 2000)
    t.assert(c.c[0].len.value == "grape 5")
}

ui.window {
    shelf()
}
